# Character / model render + pose flow — map for GPU skinned-mesh (matrix-palette LBS)

## 1. RENDER FLOW FOR MODELS TODAY

**JS push seam (one seam, two consumers — iso viewport + playtest):**
- `cart/editor/world/WorldViewport.tsx:578` and `:589` — iso viewport calls `pushLiveWorld` / `pushResidentMeshes` against a mounted `WorldLoader` node.
- `cart/editor/stage/PlaytestSurface.tsx:75`, `:82`, `:47`, `:92` — the /play surface mounts the SAME `WorldLoader` element and pushes the same three things plus `pushPlayerModel()`.
- `cart/editor/PlayRoute.tsx:3` — `WorldLoader` is the authoritative native renderer for both routes; there is no separate JS renderer for models.

**Host doors (JS → Zig):**
- `cart/editor/world/livePush.ts:372` → `__compiled_world_set_resident_meshes` (catalog of mesh geometry, keyed by string).
- `cart/editor/world/livePush.ts:239-247` → `__compiled_world_set_live_mesh_props3/2/1` (per-placement refs, presence-gated newest-first); encoders `encodeMeshRefsV3/V2/encodeMeshRefs` at `cart/editor/world/meshProps.ts:271/249/228`; resident encoder at `meshProps.ts:79`.
- Registration: `framework/v8_bindings_compiled_world.zig:594-596` (mesh props), `:606` (resident meshes), `:607-609` (player model / animation / live pose).

**Zig ingest:**
- `framework/world_loader/live_inputs.zig:264` — `LiveMeshRef { hash, x, y, z, yaw, spin_deg_per_sec, scale, mats }`; wire header sizes at `:265-267`; decoders `setLiveMeshProps/2/3` at `:286/:293/:302`.
- `framework/world_loader/runtime_live_scene.zig:109-112` — each ref becomes a scene node with `scene3d_mesh / scene3d_geom_key / scene3d_vertices`. Per-slot split (`<key>:slot-N`) at `:217`, `:536`.
- `framework/world_loader/runtime.zig:501` — per-frame stats; the loader owns the node list, GPU owns nothing loader-specific.

**GPU:**
- `framework/layout.zig:558-561` — `scene3d_geom_key` / `scene3d_vertices` / `scene3d_vert_count` are the ONLY way a mesh gets geometry (comment at `:553-557`).
- `framework/gpu/3d.zig:10333` `internGeometry(queue, key, verts, count)` — hash-keyed, bump-allocated into the retained buffer, never evicts. Cache lookup `:10290`; cache table `:287-288`, size `GEO_CACHE_SIZE = 2048` at `:280`.
- `framework/gpu/3d.zig:10320` `stageVertexRows` — THE f32-wire → packed-GPU-vertex boundary; `packVertexRow` at `:10300`.
- Retained vertex buffer created at `framework/gpu/3d.zig:9124-9130` (`render3d_retained_verts`, 256 MiB cap asserted at `:8443-8447`).
- **Instance transforms are a per-instance VERTEX BUFFER, not a uniform**: `g_instance_buf` at `:9143-9148`, staged via `makeInstance` at `:10858`, uploaded + drawn at `:12218-12223` (`pass.draw(group_slot.count, group_count, 0, 0)` — one instanced draw per (geom slice, texture) group). Foliage twin at `:12128-12130`; transparent pass at `:12488-12490`; region pass (indexed) at `:12427-12430`.
- Shader: `framework/gpu/shaders.zig:748` `scene3d_wgsl`, compiled at `framework/gpu/3d.zig:9112`.

## 2. CHARACTER SPECIFICS

**The player is N SEPARATE MESHES with per-part transforms — not one skinned mesh.**

- `cart/editor/world/playerModelPush.ts:41-77` `playerModelPayload` — slices the meshdoc into one group per Outliner part; verts re-based to each part's measured bounds center; table rows are 8 floats `[vertStart, vertCount, cx, cy, cz, r, g, b]`.
- `cart/editor/world/playerModelPush.ts:102-108` — stages via `__compiled_world_set_player_model(verts, table)` then `__compiled_world_set_player_animation(...)`.
- `framework/v8_bindings_compiled_world.zig:471-489` — door contract doc; `framework/world_loader/player_assets.zig:78-113` decodes rows into `constructor.PlayerModelGroup`.
- `framework/world/constructor.zig:113-129` `PlayerModelGroup { color, alpha, vertices, vertex_count, tex_*, position, rotation, scale }`.
- `framework/world_loader/scene_build.zig:474-494` — **one scene child node per group**, each with its own intern key `"player-model-{i}-{contenthash}"`. So a 20-part body = 20 geometry interns + 20 instance rows/frame.
- `framework/world_loader/animation.zig:65-95` `updatePlayerModelNodes` — writes `scene3d_pos/rot/scale` per part node. Live twin `:100-117`. NPC twin `:123-148`.
- Fallback stand-in: `framework/world_loader/player_assets.zig:18`.

**playerAnimation.ts outputs per-part TRS, NOT bone matrices and NOT bone rotations:**
- `cart/editor/world/playerAnimation.ts:20-22` — `NodeTransform { pos: V3; rot: V3 (euler deg) }`; clips are keyframe arrays of these.
- Pose math is done in JS by **rotating part CENTERS about measured pivots** (`rotXAt` `:35`, `rotZAt` `:85`, `swingLimb` `:49`, `swingLimbFrontal` `:95`) — there is no bone hierarchy, no parent matrices, no bind pose.
- Encoders: `encodeAnimationPayload` `:254` (`[nodeCount, clipCount, per clip …, per node px,py,pz,rx,ry,rz,sx,sy,sz]`), `encodeLivePose` `:173` (n×9).
- Consumed in Zig by `sampleClipTransform` (`framework/world_loader/animation.zig:31`) — lerps position/rotation/scale between keys, then writes node props. Clips only engage when `animation.node_count == groups.len` (`animation.zig:73`).
- Live-capture path: `cart/editor/world/poseSolve.ts:57` `solveFrontal` (MoveNet 17 keypoints → `FrontalAngles`) → `playerAnimation.ts:150` `frontalPose` → `cart/editor/stage/AnimationCaptureSurface.tsx:137-140` → `__compiled_world_set_player_live_pose`.

**playerStarter.ts / RigSection.tsx:**
- `cart/editor/model/playerStarter.ts:185` `playerStarterParts()` — one `ModelPart` per body bone, **part name IS the bone id**.
- `cart/editor/model/playerStarter.ts:238-259` `playerStarterSkeleton(modelId)` — stamps parent-relative rest `pos` onto `bodyRigBones()` and emits `meshes: { kind: 'perBone', items }` (one assignment per outliner part). This is the closest thing to a bind pose that exists.
- `cart/editor/inspector/RigSection.tsx` is the **PROP** rig (`PropRig`, texture slots, seat/container/door capabilities) — it does NOT author character bones. Character rigging is name-based only.
- `cart/editor/shell/ExportCharacterDialog.tsx:17,61-72` — shows the part-name→bone-id binding readout; writes `manifest.placeable = { as:'character', role }`.

## 3. MESH DATA FORMAT

- **Interleaved stride-8 f32: `[px,py,pz, nx,ny,nz, u,v]`. No color, no tangent, no bone data.**
- `cart/editor/data/meshDoc.ts:30` ("interleaved source verts, stride 8 (pos3/normal3/uv2)"); parse at `:250-254` (`doc.blob`, RJMD v3) and `:286` (legacy `base.blob`).
- `cart/editor/data/modelPackageStore.ts:165` — `mesh/base.blob` = raw LE stride-8, same format `__model_mesh_write` emits; write at `:184`. Files: `DOC_BLOB/LEGACY_BLOB/PARTS_META` at `meshDoc.ts:61-63`; collision at `modelPackageStore.ts:612`.
- Wire encode: `cart/editor/world/meshProps.ts:36` (doc), `:86-87` (rejects non-stride-8), `:146` (LE f32 writeout).
- Zig-side RJMD invariants: `framework/gpu/meshdoc_format.zig:50-51` (24 floats per face = 3 verts × 8).
- Package → GPU path: JS reads blob → `pushResidentMeshes` (`livePush.ts:309-374`) → `__compiled_world_set_resident_meshes` → `runtime_live_scene.zig:109` node → `framework/gpu/3d.zig:11855` / `:11579` call `internGeometry` → `stageVertexRows` packs to the 20-byte `Vertex` (`3d.zig:53-60`: pos f32×3, oct-normal snorm16×2, uv f16×2).

## 4. SKELETON RUNTIME

- **There is NO runtime pose evaluation in Zig.** `framework/skeleton/skeleton.zig` is 133 lines of pure type declarations (`Bone` `:50`, `Transform` `:26`, `Meshes` union with a `skinned: []const u8` arm at `:79-82`). Zero `mat4`/matrix/world-transform references.
- `framework/skeleton/bones_loader.zig:107` `validate()` — formation validation only (unique ids, parents resolve, no cycles, joint axis/limits, geometry-key resolvability at `:159`/`:161`). Zero matrix code (grep count = 0).
- **No JS pose evaluation either.** `runtime/skeleton/` is schema (`schema.ts`), events (`events.ts`), and rig vocabulary/templates (`rigs.ts:248 bodyRigBones()`, `:126 propRigToSkeleton`). `runtime/skeleton/index.ts` exports only those three.
- The only live pose evaluator anywhere is `cart/editor/world/playerAnimation.ts` (JS, per-part centers) + `framework/world_loader/animation.zig:31` (keyframe lerp, per-part).
- **Skeleton on disk lives in `manifest.json` as the `skeleton` field** — no separate file. `cart/editor/data/modelPackage.ts:69` (`ModelManifest.skeleton?: Skeleton`), round-tripped at `:142` and `:177`.
  - `cart/editor/data/models/characters/Bob/manifest.json` — 41 bones, each `{id, parent, transform:{pos}}`, parent-relative, no rot/scale, no mesh assignments emitted, `id: "character:player:4"`.
  - `cart/editor/data/models/characters/Player_Model_1/manifest.json` — same shape (`skeleton` present, 3 keys).
  - Package dirs hold `mesh/{base,doc,collision}.blob + parts.json`, `atlases/`, `paints/`, `shaders/` — **no bone weights anywhere on disk**.

## 5. SHADER SURFACE

- WGSL lives as Zig string constants in `framework/gpu/shaders.zig` (only `framework/gpu/effect_math.wgsl` is a real .wgsl file).
- `framework/gpu/shaders.zig:748` `scene3d_wgsl` — THE shader that draws interned mesh geometry.
  - Bind groups: `:798-802` group0 = SceneUniforms / lights storage / ShadowUniforms / shadow tex / comparison sampler. `:803-804` group1 = diffuse texture + sampler.
  - `struct VertexInput` at `:813-821` — locations 0-2 = vertex buffer 0; 3-6 = instance buffer 1. **Locations 7+ are free.**
  - `rebuild_model()` at `:840-853` — model matrix is rebuilt in the vertex shader from packed TRS; this is where a palette blend would slot in.
- Variants that duplicate the same layout: `shadow_depth_wgsl:994`, `grass_wgsl:1040`, `water_wgsl:1197`, `frond_wgsl:1409`, `scene3d_ground_prefix:1652`, `scene3d_region_prefix:1815`.
- **Vertex layout declarations (3 duplicated copies — all must be touched):**
  - `framework/gpu/3d.zig:9429-9445` (main scene pipeline)
  - `framework/gpu/3d.zig:11111-11124` (ground formula pipeline)
  - `framework/gpu/3d.zig:11196-11209` (region formula pipeline)
  - Slim/foliage twin at `:9451-9459`.
- **Bind group layout declarations:** scene group0 at `framework/gpu/3d.zig:9213-9243`; texture group1 at `:9261-9285`; **storage-buffer group1 precedent** (`g_ground_bgl`, reused by both ground and region pipelines) at `:9343-9350`, pool + bind groups at `:9351-9374` and `:9387-9410`. A bone-palette storage buffer should copy this exact shape.
- The "megashader compose" system is **JS-side and for MATERIALS only** — `cart/editor/render3d/shaders/compose.ts:1-20` splits a 730 KB generated `FILL_FUNCS` dispatch into per-set modules; pushed to Zig via `__model_region_formula` (`3d.zig:8722`) / `__compiled_world_set_live_material`, compiled lazily at `3d.zig:11173-11242`. It does not touch the core mesh vertex path.

## 6. EXISTING SKINNING / PALETTE ATTEMPT

**None. Zero prior art.**
- Every `palette` hit in `framework/` is a COLOR palette (e.g. `framework/world_loader/geometry.zig:10-20`, `framework/image/quantize.zig`) or a material palette.
- Every `skin`/`skinned` hit in the compiled-world path means **material/texture skinning** — a face wearing an assigned material: `framework/world_loader/instances.zig:392-393`, `:412-416`; `framework/world_loader/scene_build.zig:1387`, `:1406`; `framework/world_loader/runtime.zig:231`, `:259`; `framework/v8_bindings_compiled_world.zig:328`; `framework/world/constructor.zig:723`, `:2280`; `cart/editor/world/pieceSkins.ts:186`.
- `framework/world/constructor.zig:216` `MeshPropInstance` and `:144-177` `MeshPropMesh` carry NO bone fields (key, color, bounds, verts, material_vertices, tex, slots, door, collision boxes/triangles).
- `bone_matrices`, `bonePalette`, `matrix_palette`, `boneIndices`, `skinWeight`, `joint_index` — **zero hits repo-wide.**
- The only true skinning references are declarative: `framework/skeleton/skeleton.zig:79-82` (`Meshes.skinned` union arm), `runtime/skeleton/schema.ts:83`, `runtime/skeleton/events.ts:53-55`, and the accepting test at `framework/testing/unit/bones_loader.zig:67-76` ("a skinned-mesh player rig"). Declared and validated, never rendered.
- **No "animated-content lump / stepX" path exists.** Lump types: `framework/world/mapfile.zig:29` `player_model=9`, `:31` `player_animation=10`, `:67` `mesh_props=20`, `:89` `npc_models=24`. `framework/gpu/animations.zig:1-16` is the UI/CSS latch animation registry, unrelated to characters. `stepX` matches only unrelated cart constants.

---

## Where skinning plugs in — files an implementer must touch

1. **`framework/gpu/3d.zig`** — the load-bearing one. Add `SkinVertex`/second vertex buffer or widen `Vertex` (`:53-60`); add bone-index+weight attributes to the vertex layouts at **`:9429-9445`** (and `:11111-11124`, `:11196-11209` if the ground/region pipelines share the skinned geometry); create a bone-palette storage buffer + bind group layout copying the `g_ground_bgl` pattern at **`:9343-9374`**; extend `packVertexRow`/`stageVertexRows` (**`:10300-10331`**) and `internGeometry` (**`:10333`**) to carry the extra attributes; add a skinned pipeline + a `pass.setBindGroup(2, palette_bg)` before the draw at **`:12219-12223`**.
2. **`framework/gpu/shaders.zig`** — new `scene3d_skinned_wgsl` (or `@location(7,8)` added to `VertexInput` at **`:813-821`**) plus a `@group(2) @binding(0) var<storage, read> palette: array<mat4x4f>` declaration next to **`:798-804`**, blending into `rebuild_model` at **`:840-853`**. `shadow_depth_wgsl:994` needs the same treatment or skinned meshes lose shadows.
3. **`framework/layout.zig`** — new node fields beside `scene3d_geom_key`/`scene3d_vertices` at **`:558-561`**: a palette slice + bone count (`scene3d_bone_matrices: ?[]const f32`, `scene3d_bone_count: u32`), so the loader can hand a pose to the GPU per node the way it hands ground data today.
4. **`framework/world/constructor.zig`** — `PlayerModelGroup` (**`:113-129`**) becomes one skinned mesh + bind-pose inverses instead of N center-rebased groups; `MeshPropMesh` (**`:144`**) gains optional skin arrays if props are to skin too.
5. **`framework/world_loader/animation.zig`** — **`:65-95`** `updatePlayerModelNodes` is where per-part TRS writing gets replaced by a bone-hierarchy walk producing `world[i] * inverseBind[i]` into the palette. `sampleClipTransform` (**`:31`**) already lerps TRS per node and can feed bone locals unchanged.
6. **`framework/world_loader/player_assets.zig`** (**`:78-113`**) + **`framework/world_loader/scene_build.zig`** (**`:474-494`**) — decode a skin payload and emit ONE mesh node instead of N, with the palette attached.
7. **`framework/v8_bindings_compiled_world.zig`** — a `__compiled_world_set_player_skin` / v4 mesh-prop door beside **`:607-609`**, following the presence-gated versioning convention (`livePush.ts:239-247`).
8. **`cart/editor/world/playerModelPush.ts`** (**`:41-108`**) + **`cart/editor/world/playerAnimation.ts`** (**`:150-266`**) — stop re-basing verts to part centers and emit per-vertex bone indices/weights (part index → bone id is already 1:1 via `playerStarter.ts:185-190`); change clip output from posed part centers to **bone-local rotations** so the Zig hierarchy walk can consume them.

**Cheapest viable seed:** the outliner part ↔ bone name binding is already exact and already validated (`ExportCharacterDialog.tsx:61-72`, `bones_loader.zig:159`), so rigid-bind weights (weight 1.0, index = part rank) can be generated with zero authoring work — that turns today's N-draw per-part figure into one skinned draw without changing any art pipeline, and smooth weights can follow later.</result>
